rationale: With only 26 minutes to close, AXGN is trading at 92.2% of its intraday range after a 21% gap-up on no news, showing signs of consolidation near the high ($49.47 vs high $49.97) with declining volume on the last candles. The risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction: a long near the top of a massive gap-up move with 26 minutes remaining risks a late-day fade, while a short against strong momentum with the stock holding near highs and above VWAP by ~4.5% is equally dangerous. The spread and ATR relative to the remaining time window make a clean setup unlikely before forced liquidation.
